title: Pelargonium graveolens essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Pelargonium graveolens essential oil is a concentrated aromatic compound derived from the leaves of the geranium plant. It is widely used in herbalism for its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and calming properties. This essential oil is often employed to support respiratory health, alleviate stress, and promote skin healing. It can be applied topically, inhaled through diffusion, or diluted for internal use under professional guidance. Its versatility makes it a valuable remedy in both traditional and modern holistic practices.
